quarantine.rule: 8-gram word-level containment, zero tolerance, build aborts on hit

wikitext103.what: wikitext-103-raw-v1 validation+test article leads (2016 Wikipedia snapshot, pre-2022 by construction)

hc3-human.what: HC3 human answers, formal QA genres (finance/medicine/open_qa/wiki_csai); human text predates ChatGPT

arena-2024-25.what: lmarena-ai/arena-human-preference-140k shard 0 - first assistant turns from Chatbot Arena battles; shard 0 timestamps span 2025-04-17..2025-07-24 (53 distinct models incl. claude-opus-4, grok-4, gemini-2.5, deepseek-r1-0528)

gaps: human-corpus-v1.json did not exist at build time (checked implementation/tests/battery/), so the planned half-for-training slice is absent

arena-140k shard 0 covers models to 2025-07 (incl. claude-opus-4, grok-4, gemini-2.5, deepseek-r1); nothing newer than 2025-07 (no GPT-5.x-class 2026 outputs), so decay against 2026 frontier models is expected and must be measured, not assumed
human side lacks professional marketing copy and personal-essay genres; wikipedia+QA only
